{{Quote|The fact that you found your way here means that you seek something you cannot find anyplace else.|Boulad to Captain Typho|<ref name="sos" />''}}
'''Boulad''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cragmoloid/Legends|Cragmoloid]] who worked as a [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] and [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]]. During his hunt for the killer of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Typho]] paid Boulad five thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for information regarding the whereabouts of any [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] at a specific time and [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. He learned that [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] went to [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] the same time Amidala and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] were there.<ref name="sos" />
